findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_security_check, domain_intel · Private data: za_tender_search, za_normalize_phone, domain_intel, asia_mobile_network_lookup · Public sink: za_normalize_phone, email_security_check, domain_intel, africa_mobile_network_lookup, asia_mobile_network_lookup, country_languages_lookup · Destructive: za_validate_tax_number, za_validate_company_number, za_normalize_phone, africa_mobile_network_lookup, asia_mobile_network_lookup, india_gstin_validate, address_format_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_security_check, domain_intel · Private data: za_tender_search, za_normalize_phone, domain_intel, asia_mobile_network_lookup · Public sink: za_normalize_phone, email_security_check, domain_intel, africa_mobile_network_lookup, asia_mobile_network_lookup, country_languages_lookup · Destructive: za_validate_tax_number, za_validate_company_number, za_normalize_phone, africa_mobile_network_lookup, asia_mobile_network_lookup, india_gstin_validate, address_format_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
